tools.name: search-banksapi-docs
tools.description: Search the BANKSapi documentation. Use this tool to find information about BANKSapi features, API endpoints, integration guides, and technical documentation. The query should be a natural language question about BANKSapi.

tools.name: get-banksapi-docs-page
tools.description: Fetch the Markdown for a single BANKSapi docs page. Accepts a docs path (e.g., /guide/quickstart) or a full URL; any .md/.html suffix and section index (e.g. /guide) are handled.
